AutoVariable.label: Charge key
AutoVariable.tooltip: Hold to store ticks. Shared by warp and doubletap.

AutoVariable.label: Charge passively
AutoVariable.tooltip: Store ticks while standing still or moving.

AutoVariable.label: Charge in jump
AutoVariable.tooltip: Charge passively in jump. This will make you fall slower.

AutoVariable.label: Charge when keys released
AutoVariable.tooltip: Charge passively before full stop after releasing movement keys.

AutoVariable.label: Movement ratio
AutoVariable.tooltip: Every nth movement tick is passively converted to charge.

AutoVariable.label: Draw tick text
AutoVariable.tooltip: Shows how many ticks are stored.

AutoVariable.label: Draw tick bar
AutoVariable.tooltip: Draws a bar indicating stored ticks.

AutoVariable.label: Enable warp
AutoVariable.tooltip: Spends stored ticks to burst movement.

AutoVariable.label: Warp ticks
AutoVariable.tooltip: How many stored ticks to spend when warping.

AutoVariable.label: Warp key
AutoVariable.tooltip: Spend stored ticks to accelerate.

AutoVariable.label: Dodge projectiles
AutoVariable.tooltip: Dodges enemy projectiles using warp.

AutoVariable.label: Demoknight mode
AutoVariable.tooltip: This will make you do a swing charge with warp (attack, charge, warp).

AutoVariable.label: Peek mode
AutoVariable.tooltip: This will teleport you for a tick and then teleport you back.

AutoVariable.label: Warp when hit
AutoVariable.tooltip: Warp whenever someone melees you or shoots you with hitscan.

AutoVariable.label: Warp forwards
AutoVariable.tooltip: Warp when hit option.

AutoVariable.label: Warp backwards
AutoVariable.tooltip: Warp when hit option.

AutoVariable.label: Warp left
AutoVariable.tooltip: Warp when hit option.

AutoVariable.label: Warp right
AutoVariable.tooltip: Warp when hit option.

AutoVariable.label: Enable doubletap
AutoVariable.tooltip: Spends stored ticks to fire again on the same server frame. Charge it with the tickbase charge key or passive charge.

AutoVariable.label: Anti-warp
AutoVariable.tooltip: Stop movement on the extra ticks so you do not slide.

AutoVariable.label: Doubletap key
AutoVariable.tooltip: Optional hold/toggle to allow doubletap. Leave empty to always allow.

LabeledObject.label: Key mode
LabeledObject.tooltip: Controls what the doubletap key does.
